gloss: anmitsu; Japanese dessert with red bean paste, agar jelly, and fruit

definitions.gloss: anmitsu; Japanese dessert with red bean paste, agar jelly, and fruit
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese cold dessert consisting of cubes of agar jelly ({寒天|かんてん}), sweet red bean paste ({餡|あん}), fruit pieces, mochi balls, and a sweet syrup. Served in a bowl, typically at Japanese-style tea houses and dessert shops.

examples.japanese: あんみつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あんみつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Summer is the season when anmitsu is at its best.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浅草|あさくさ}→浅草：28393_asakusa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{甘味処|かんみどころ}→甘味処：17144_kanmidokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧あんみつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶品|ぜっぴん}→絶品：13811_zeppin⟧だった。
examples.english: The anmitsu I had at a sweets shop in Asakusa was exquisite.

notes:
A classic Japanese dessert combining ⟦{寒天|かんてん}→寒天：12463_kanten⟧ (agar jelly) cubes, ⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧ (sweet red bean paste), fruit, ⟦{求肥|ぎゅうひ}→求肥：21941_gyuuhi⟧ (soft mochi), and ⟦{黒蜜|くろみつ}→黒蜜：24332_kuromitsu⟧ (brown sugar syrup) or other sweet syrups. The name comes from ⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧ (bean paste) + ⟦{蜜|みつ}→蜜：14085_mitsu⟧ (syrup/honey).

FORMS:
- ⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧あんみつ: anmitsu topped with ice cream or whipped cream
- ⟦{白玉|しらたま}→白玉：13711_shiratama⟧あんみつ: anmitsu with shiratama dango (rice flour dumplings)
- ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧あんみつ: anmitsu with matcha-flavored elements

CULTURAL NOTE:
Anmitsu is a quintessential summer dessert in Japan, strongly associated with ⟦{甘味処|かんみどころ}→甘味処：17144_kanmidokoro⟧ (traditional Japanese sweets shops). It originated in the early 20th century as a variation of みつ{豆|まめ} (mitsumame), which is the same dessert without the bean paste.

RELATED WORDS:
- みつ{豆|まめ}: similar dessert without red bean paste
- ⟦{甘味処|かんみどころ}→甘味処：17144_kanmidokoro⟧: traditional Japanese sweets shop
